records.title: Fundraising Turkey Dinner
records.location: Spearfish Senior Center 1306 N 10th St Spearfish, SD 57783
records.description: The Spearfish Senior Center will be hosting their Annual Fundraising Turkey Dinner on Saturday, November 21, 2026. Spearfish Senior Center Annual Meeting will be held at 11AM and dinner will follow the meeting at approx. 11:30am. Serving turkey dinner with all the fixings and dessert. Dinner is a $12 donation. Voting for Board of Directors will also take place from 9AM-2PM. This is a great time to stop by and pay annual membership dues which are $35. Open to the public, everyone welcome! The dinner will be held at the Spearfish Senior Center located at 1306 N 10th St. Spearfish, SD 57783.

records.title: Spell Jar Bar Ornament Edition

records.description: ??? SPELL JAR NIGHT - ORNAMENT EDITION! ??? A little magic, a little intention, and a whole lot of creativity! ?? Join us at Let's Rock Crystal Shop for a fun and magical evening as we create our very own Spell Jar Ornaments! Create a beautiful, one-of-a-kind spell jar ornament filled with your own personal intentions! You'll get to choose from a variety of herbs, crystals, and charms to create an ornament that reflects whatever energy you'd like to welcome into your life. ? Love & Self-Love ? Protection & Peace ? Abundance & Prosperity ? Healing & Harmony ? Happiness & New Beginnings ? Or any intention your heart desires! Whether you hang it on your Christmas tree, gift it to someone special, or keep it in your sacred space, your ornament will serve as a beautiful reminder of the intentions you're setting. ?? All supplies are included! Just bring yourself, your creativity, and a little holiday magic! ?? Make it. Fill it. Set your intention. Take your magic home! ?? Grab a friend and join us for a magical evening at Let's Rock Crystal Shop!
